g.text: Validate JSON and served embedding model; resolve includeMeaning flag
Drop nonstring/whitespace-only elements; trim retained strings
No retained inputs or validation fails?
Launch at most eight EmbeddingAsync tasks with meaningLimit 10
Await tasks in input order and retain result order
Emit five-value vector X, Y, Z, M, Radius and form provenance
Attach entity ID and optional meaning neighbors
Compute usage as whitespace-separated word counts, minimum one per retained input
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. The response vector here is five form values, not evidence that a conventional
learned embedding model was run. Input trimming/filtering and usage counting belong to
this HTTP contract. Concurrency eight is a literal wrapper limit. Exceptions from
embedding tasks propagate; other tasks in the same group may already be running. Native
form and meaning retrieval remain nested.
